title: Semántica de campos y reemplazo observado de recurso vegetal
scope: Correlación en el emulador local y cotejo independiente del consumidor nativo. No demuestra retirada espacial ni replantación oficial, ni identidad del mapa.

capture.kind: captura del emulador local; no oficial de Ankama

fields.7: int64 passed as bOm.kEB; accessor axv
fields.8: int32 passed as bOm.kEC; accessor axx

native_field_mapping.ownership_consumer: cWn.eVy compares bOm.axv() (field 7) with biB.cBt() (current character account ID) in its resource permission path. A positive unequal value participates in the RESOURCE_RESERVED path; territorial checks may add exceptions.
native_field_mapping.field8_consumer: Field 8 is stored as kEC/axx. The inspected resource ownership comparison uses field 7, not field 8.
native_field_mapping.identity_note: cFL constructs/registers the world actor from the resource reference and position. The inspected field-7 consumer is an account-ID comparison; it is not used there as the actor UID or resource reference.

observed_sequence.note: resource action request immediately preceding the occupation
occupation start for the same x/y
new resource-partition create at the same cell; no stage-1 12782 update was observed for this replant

interpretation.field7: The client code gives field 7 account-ownership semantics. In this capture its values are timestamp-like and are carried unchanged by later 12782 state updates; the evidence does not establish why the producer populated them that way. They are not the resource reference or actor UID.
interpretation.replanting: At the same x/y in this captured session, the old reference 182 had stage 0, followed later by a 13135 create for reference 139 at stage 1. This supports replacement by a new resource partition rather than changing the old partition to stage 1.
limits: The listed packets do not expose map ID, so same session and coordinates are established, but same map is not asserted from these packets alone.
Only field6=false is present in these sampled plant-resource records. Bytecode shows it is passed as kEA and affects DELETE handling; this sample does not characterize the true case.
Packet correlation does not prove what server-side database column originally supplied field 7.
